title: FastAPI Beginner-to-Professional Final Assessment
attempt_policy: Suggested: allow two attempts, then require remediation and a review of missed outcomes. Configure platform-side enforcement only after confirming the existing exam system supports it.
outcomes: Design clear FastAPI route and data contracts.
Use validation, response models, dependencies and database operations safely.
Explain authentication/authorization, async, integration and operational risks.
Plan tests, monitoring, deployment and recovery.
remediation: Route learners to the corresponding lesson and exercise; do not mark a certificate as issued until server-side exam passing is implemented and verified.
notes: Questions and answer keys remain draft within backend content. Verify that the deployed assessment route does not expose answer keys before using this blueprint in production.
